heading: INT. NEOSPORT ARENA - FINALS STAGE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. NEOSPORT ARENA - FINALS STAGE - NIGHT
Banks of LED.
Ten thousand seats, a hush.
Six chairs on a raised dais, six headsets.
Stage lights low.
Overhead, a countdown reads 00:04.
The match has been decided.
Aftermath: the winners hold position, the losers don't.

HEAD REFEREE LIANG PETROV, 40s, headset and clipboard, stands at the bench with TECHNICAL DIRECTOR AMARA SOYINKA, 30s, laptop on a cart, and ADJUDICATOR FELIX BRANDT, 50s, steel-rimmed glasses and a rulebook.
CLOSE ON the main screen.
The final frame freezes: a character mid-leap, a glitch rippling across its sprite.
Hold the broadcast. All stations hold. Judges to the dais.
units.name: PETROV

units.text: I've got packet loss on station four. Latency spiked at one-forty-two. That's not their connection. That's us.
units.name: SOYINKA

units.text: Rule eleven point three. Interference by hardware fault voids the round if verified within sixty seconds. We are at fifty.
units.name: BRANDT

units.text: THE ARBITERS' PANEL, five officials in grey blazers, file up the steps as one, tablets raised, faces unreadable.
ANGLE ON station four.
A competitor, a HOODIE PLAYER, lowers his hands from the keyboard and sits perfectly still, hood up, eyes down.
Who's on four?
units.name: PETROV

units.text: Registered as Ghost_Rider. Real name's not on the sheet. He signed in under a handle.
units.name: SOYINKA

units.text: Under a handle? That's a violation. Players must register legal names before qualifiers.
units.name: BRANDT

units.text: THE HOODIE PLAYER pulls back his hood.
Late 20s, calm, a faint grin.
DANTE VASQUEZ.
Dante Vasquez. Since you asked.
units.name: DANTE

units.text: Murmur.
The ten thousand lean in.
Soyinka turns her screen to Petrov.
Brandt flips pages, Petrov unclips his radio, the panel exchanges glances, and the countdown ticks to zero.
It's not a fault, Liang. It's a patch. Someone pushed a build during the round. The signature is his.
units.name: SOYINKA

units.text: WE SEE Dante rise, step off the dais, and hand the referee a drive.
It's all on there. Every match. Every edit. I wanted somebody to ask.
units.name: DANTE

units.text: Right. Everybody sit down. We're going to do this by the book.
units.name: PETROV
